singleSourced.value: We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience.
singleSourced.context:
FromSoftware acknowledged the hangups with a message on its X/Twitter page, saying, "We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience."

The message to fans also notified them that the first test had been closed before its originally planned time of 7 a.m.

It's unclear if the remaining times have been impacted, with the studio's message on social media, meanwhile, promising to "work on improving the servers" and "announced future schedules at a later date."

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused to those who were waiting for the first The Duskbloods network test due to game server issues.
